name: partial_gap_fill_scalp_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When NIFTY gaps up 0.5–1.5% at open, institutional VWAP algorithms benchmarked to the previous close face immediate adverse fills and systematically begin selling against the gap within the first few minutes to close their benchmark gap; market makers who delta-hedged overnight at the prior close also reduce exposure at the elevated open. This dual flow creates a magnetic pull toward the 50% gap level — the midpoint between the gap open and the prior close — that typically initiates within 1–5 minutes of the open. At 5-second resolution, a 2-minute RSI overbought/oversold reading pinpoints when the initial gap-direction momentum has stalled and the VWAP anchor flow is about to dominate, allowing entry at the precise turn rather than after a full 1-minute bar confirms the reversal.

indicators.name: gap_pct
indicators.purpose: Measures NIFTY index gap size relative to previous session close. No scaling needed — this is a daily level computed once per session from the first bar's open. The 0.5–1.5% band filters out noise gaps (<0.5% have no meaningful VWAP dislocation) and news-driven gaps (>1.5% where institutional behavior is directional, not anchoring).

indicators.name: rsi_24
indicators.purpose: 2-minute RSI (24 bars × 5s = 120s). Original used RSI(7) at 1-min (7 minutes of history). Compressed to 2 minutes because we are catching the FAST stall of the initial gap-direction burst, not waiting for a confirmed reversal. The 2-minute window is sensitive enough to register exhaustion as institutional gap-direction momentum slows before the VWAP anchor flow takes over. Scaling 7 min → 2 min is justified because we target the first reversion leg (30–300s), not the full partial fill.

indicators.name: gap_moved_fraction
indicators.purpose: Fraction of the gap already moved toward the partial fill target. Entry is blocked when > 30% of the gap has already been covered — at that point the easy first-leg opportunity has passed and chasing the remaining move has poor risk/reward. This is a threshold filter, not a time-series indicator; no period scaling required.

conditions: gap_pct between -1.5 and -0.5 (NIFTY gapped DOWN 0.5–1.5% — expecting partial fill UP)
rsi_24 on prior bar < 30 (oversold — gap-down selling has exhausted)
current bar is green (close > open) — first sign the selling has stalled
gap_moved_fraction < 0.30 (price still near the gap open, not already filling)
VIX < 22 (moderate volatility — gap fills are more predictable)
buy_ce.confirmation: First green 5-second bar after RSI(24) drops below 30, within the 09:20–09:45 entry window

conditions: gap_pct between +0.5 and +1.5 (NIFTY gapped UP 0.5–1.5% — expecting partial fill DOWN)
rsi_24 on prior bar > 70 (overbought — gap-up buying has exhausted)
current bar is red (close < open) — first sign the buying has stalled
gap_moved_fraction < 0.30 (price still near the gap open, not already filling)
buy_pe.confirmation: First red 5-second bar after RSI(24) rises above 70, within the 09:20–09:45 entry window

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option pts = ~10 spot pts adverse move. If NIFTY extends the gap by another 10 pts after entry, the VWAP anchoring thesis has failed — institutions are following the gap direction rather than anchoring to prev close. A 0.5–1.5% NIFTY gap is 110–330 pts; a 10-pt extension is a minor continuation signal that clearly breaks the partial-fill hypothesis. At ATM delta ~0.5, 10 spot pts = ~5 option pts.
exit.target_rationale: 8 option pts ≈ 16 spot pts of gap reversion. A 0.5–1.5% NIFTY gap = 110–330 spot pts; the 50% partial fill target = 55–165 pts. We capture the FIRST leg (~16 pts) of that reversion within 30–300 seconds as VWAP algorithm flow initiates — this is 10–30% of the full partial fill, taken before momentum fades. Consistent with 5-minute NIFTY ATM option typical range of 7–15 pts (at delta 0.5). Risk:reward = 1:1.6.
exit.eod_rule: flatten at 09:45 IST (585 minutes) — gap fill dynamics weaken sharply after 09:45; entries restricted to 09:20-09:45 IST

filters.vix_filter: VIX < 22 — in high-volatility environments NIFTY gaps are event-driven and less likely to partially fill on institutional VWAP anchoring alone
filters.time_filter: Entry only 09:20–09:45 IST (25-minute window) — gap fill dynamics weaken sharply after 09:45 as other intraday patterns dominate NIFTY flow
filters.volume_filter: none — NIFTY index volume is aggregate across all constituents and reliably reflects institutional activity
filters.trend_filter: gap size 0.5–1.5% only — below 0.5% there is insufficient VWAP dislocation to trigger anchor flow; above 1.5% gaps are news-driven with directional continuation risk
filters.spread_filter: limit order execution — no bid-ask spread cost in this pipeline

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — VWAP anchoring by institutions is a structural behavior driven by benchmark reporting requirements that are unlikely to change

adaptation_notes: Original was for top-25 Nifty50 individual stocks. Adapted to the NIFTY index itself, where VWAP anchoring is even stronger since every major FII/DII benchmarks to NIFTY, not individual stocks. RSI lookback compressed from 7 min (original RSI(7) at 1-min) to 2 min (24 bars at 5s) because at 5-second bars we target the fast stall of the gap-direction burst, not a full reversal confirmation. Hold time compressed from 10–45 min (original) to 30–300s because we target only the initial reversion impulse as VWAP algorithms begin executing — we do not need to hold for the complete partial fill. Entry window kept tight at 09:20–09:45 matching original logic. Gap size filter (0.5–1.5%) carried over unchanged — the same logic applies at the index level. ATR-based stop from original replaced with fixed option-premium stop since we trade options.
weaknesses: NIFTY gap fill can be delayed by macro news flow in the first 10 minutes — thesis may fail on RBI policy days, Fed days, and global risk-off events
2-minute RSI may give false exhaustion signals on strong trending gap days where NIFTY continues the gap direction
Low frequency — only 0-2 trades per session in the narrow 09:20–09:45 window; strategy contributes limited daily PnL
Gap size filter (0.5–1.5%) will miss many trading days where NIFTY gaps outside this range
